verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building agents. A developer tool could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product. The Agent Server's "Assistants" are user-configured instances of a user's own graph, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
